biography.plain_text: Jérôme Joseph Jean Delmau is a property businessman based in Monaco, with Italian and French nationality. Born in Albi, he worked as a property negotiator and became a partner in several property companies. He established Juli Invest to buy and resell buildings, businesses and interests in other real estate companies.

long_biography.plain_text:
Jérôme Delmau invested in Monalisa 3 using both personal funds and a private loan from Jean-Michel Delmau, the company's manager and largest shareholder. Jérôme held more than a third of the company alongside Jean-Michel and Marine Delmau, who owned the remaining shares.

In 2019, he established Insignia as a commercial advisory company, with a remit covering market research, business development and assistance with project financing and contract negotiations. His wife, Ksenia Jouravleva, joined him in managing the firm. By 2026, they shared that responsibility with Rajinder Chatha, who became a fellow managing partner.
